title: Remove plaintext default credentials from role defaults and Readme
description: roles/system/defaults/main.yml commits ssh_password_pi and wifi_password in plaintext, and Readme.md documents the image login password. Per Operating_Protocol.md section 9 these should move to environment lookups or vault references, and the exposed credentials should be rotated on any deployed devices. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0; see docs/PRD.md OQ-4.
close_reason: Replaced plaintext defaults with env lookups (BRIDGE_PI_PASSWORD, BRIDGE_WIFI_PASSWORD), added fail-fast credential_checks.yml (verified: unset env fails, short passphrase fails, valid values pass), removed hardcoded password from Readme and documented the env vars. Rotation on deployed devices filed separately.

title: Fix broken import: main.yml imports inkywhat.yml but only inkywhatAP.yml exists
description: Adoption audit found roles/system/tasks/main.yml:6 imports inkywhat.yml, but the file was renamed to inkywhatAP.yml (commits 4d7a3c5/44c2090). ansible-playbook run.yml should fail at parse time on current HEAD. Fix the import (and confirm whether the playbook has been run since the rename). Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0; see docs/PRD.md OQ-1.
close_reason: Fixed import in main.yml (inkywhat.yml -> inkywhatAP.yml); ansible-playbook run.yml --syntax-check passes

title: Rotate exposed credentials on deployed bridge devices
description: The previously committed defaults (pi login password, WPA2 passphrase, and the password formerly documented in Readme.md) were public in git history and remain in history even after removal from HEAD (commit history: roles/system/defaults/main.yml, Readme.md). Any device built with those defaults still uses them. Operator action: change the pi password and WiFi passphrase on deployed devices, or rebuild with BRIDGE_PI_PASSWORD/BRIDGE_WIFI_PASSWORD set. Follow-up to Transparent_Bridge_Eth_to_Wifi-9d6.

title: Verify python3.9 interpreter pin against Bookworm target
description: roles/system/defaults/main.yml pins ansible_python_interpreter to /usr/bin/python3.9, but Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm (supported per commit 284b786) ships Python 3.11. Verify a clean Bookworm build and correct the pin if broken. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0; see docs/PRD.md OQ-3.
close_reason: Changed ansible_python_interpreter from /usr/bin/python3.9 to /usr/bin/python3, which resolves correctly on both Bullseye (3.9) and Bookworm (3.11). Syntax check passes. End-to-end verification against a physical Bookworm device is covered by the smoke-tests bead Transparent_Bridge_Eth_to_Wifi-s9t. Note: py_version 3.8.0 in defaults is unused dead config.

title: Create smoke tests and test catalog for the WiFi bridge build
description: No tests exist anywhere in the repository; project.manifest.yaml marks the test_development phase incomplete and project_layout.tests_dir is null. Create validation tests (hostapd up, br0 bridge active, avahi/lighttpd running, client DHCP passthrough) and populate docs/test_catalog/. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0; see docs/PRD.md OQ-5.
close_reason: Created ./run-tests.sh entrypoint (library contract: --list/--category, RESULT line, exit codes), tests/unit/ (syntax check + 5 credential-gate scenarios, all passing locally) and tests/smoke/smoke_test.sh (11 device-side checks over SSH: services, br0 topology, AP mode, placeholder passphrase, web surface, label timer). Catalog populated: docs/test_catalog/{README,smoke_tests,unit_tests}.md incl. manual TC-S-006 DHCP passthrough. Manifest: tests_dir=tests/, test_development phase complete. Smoke suite verified for skip-when-no-device and fail-when-SMOKE_TARGET-unreachable; not yet run against physical hardware.

title: Configure beads Dolt remote for cross-machine sync
description: bd dolt push reports no Dolt remote configured. The .beads/issues.jsonl export syncs via git, but the Dolt-native sync (refs/dolt/data on the git remote, per AGENTS.md) is not set up. Operator should pick a remote form (git+ssh, DoltHub, or Azure) and run the bd dolt remote setup. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0 at adoption.

title: Reconcile GPG signer: .env candidate differs from git signingkey
description: Adoption audit found .env GPG_SIGNING_KEY_ID=25C253158685D428 (init-project.sh candidate) while git config user.signingkey is 266E6A4865C6C51D with commit.gpgsign=true, so commits are signed by a key other than the candidate. Operator should choose the project attestation signer via the signer proposal ADR in DECISIONS.md and record it in project.manifest.yaml prompt_provenance.attestation, making .env agree. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0.

title: Decide fate of orphaned dhcp-helper.yml task
description: roles/system/tasks/dhcp-helper.yml exists but main.yml does not import it (parprouted-era relay likely superseded by true L2 bridging in bridge.yml). Decide whether it is dead code to delete or an optional mode to document. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0; see docs/PRD.md OQ-2 and FR-011.
close_reason: Decided: dead code, removed. dhcp-helper.yml was the parprouted-era L3 relay companion, never imported by main.yml in any commit, and its Device_Label_WP.service copy pointed at a nonexistent source file. Deleted dhcp-helper.yml, etc/default/dhcp-helper, and the equally dead usr/lib/systemd/system/parprouted.service. Decision frozen as ADR-002 in DECISIONS.md; PRD FR-011/OQ-2 updated; syntax check passes. Recoverable from git history if an L3 relay mode is ever wanted.
